liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the first-set Shakedown decent, among a respectable opening set; Opening Shakedown was very explosive, with the band hot from the start [12][16]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer names it as an especially good second-set performance; Described as the closing sermon delivered by Jerry; Brent had found his tone [11][16]
- **C.C. Rider** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry played C.C. Rider especially nicely [18]
- **On The Road Again** (1 review): Reviewer enjoys the On The Road Again performance, with a joke about finding Inspector Thelma [20]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Reviewer likens the Ramble On Rose placement to a China>Rider, though it isn't present [15]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer calls Let It Grow off the charts [15]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Second set opened quickly with deep psychedelia in Playin', with Bobby playing wildly [12]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer counts this Bertha among all-time favorite performances [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-09-26.mtx.chappel.sb10.30117.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 153 min; rated 4.92/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Second set has a small gap in Drums [1]
- **gd81-09-26.sbd.miller.18110.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 154 min; rated 4.38/5 by 37 [2]. Said about its sound: Both sets fit neatly, each on an 80-minute disc, in this matrix; Reviewer has known the tape for years and enjoys it in CD quality; Reviewer rates the sound quality as very good [11][13][18][19]
- **gd1981-09-26.aud.unknown.willy.9418.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1981-09-26.152508.beyer201prescott-holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 21 songs; 138 min [5]

## Around the show

- Band started about an hour or more late, reportedly because they were attending a Rolling Stones concert elsewhere [12]
- Reviewer's Buffalo day included roast beef sandwiches at the Anchor Bar and Deadheads on the USS The Sullivans [14]
- Encore Johnny B. Goode was played in honor of Chuck Berry's birthday [18]
- Reviewer's first Dead tape in 1982 was the first set of this show [19]
- An MC flip occurs about 8:06 into Drums and was used as a track break [3]
- Security reportedly confiscated several tape decks near the soundboard, making the show legendary among tapers [5]
- Someone was stuck in Buffalo airport for twelve hours on standby [25]
- Reviewer found it more special than the Salt Palace 1981 show, with novel song choices and big energy [15]
- Reviewer notes this was a mini East Coast tour before the band went to Europe [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-09-26.mtx.chappel.sb10.30117.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: SBD (18110) + AUD (12554) [1]. Also: Matrix in which Shakedown, C.C. Rider and about eight minutes of Drums come from audience source only [1]
- **gd81-09-26.sbd.miller.18110.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Soundboard went to cassette, DAT, then CD via Charlie Miller, with audience patches [2]
- **gd1981-09-26.aud.unknown.willy.9418.shnf**: transferred by Willy Munder; source: AUD>MC>?>CD [3]. Also: Audience source retracked with CD Wave, Shntool and CE2K; audio discs came from Scott Shindell [3]
- **gd1981-09-26.152508.beyer201prescott-holbrook.flac2448**: taped by David Prescott; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Microphones: Beyer M201c (worn in hat??) Recorder: Sony TC-D5 Maxell UDXLII no nr Location: Balcony behind and above drums [5]. Also: As of 2021 only four unique audience sources of this show exist on LMA [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1981-09-26 Community War Memorial Auditorium, Buffalo, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1981-09-26-community-war-memorial-auditorium-buffalo-ny-usa/) [26]
- Photo by Jurassic Blueberries (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead 9-26-1981 Buffalo Community War Memorial Auditorium - Original Cassette Tape Case Set List Artwork](https://www.flickr.com/photos/59863270@N07/21074081175/) [27]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/59863270@N07/21074081175/) [28]
